lines.text: Remember to pick up the kids at three
Buy bread and milk on the way home
Call the plumber about the kitchen tap
Send the report to Anna by Friday
Dentist appointment on Tuesday at 9:30 am
Check the oven before you leave the house
We need to talk about the budget for next year
Zoe is allergic to peanuts and shellfish
Water the plants in the living room
Return the library books by the end of the week
The quick onyx goblin jumps over the lazy dwarf
Meeting notes: ship v2 on Monday
Ask Ivy whether Eddie can attend the party
Pack socks, a hat, two shirts and a coat
Is it 0K to use the old API for now?
Order 24 boxes of A4 paper and 6 toner cartridges
See you at the cafe near the old station
Fix the leak under the sink
Email Mr. Okafor about invoice 4471
Plan: wake at 6, run at 7, work from 9 to 5
